name: Stable Unlabeled Compression / Radon Number (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm{sUSC}=n$, while $\mathrm{Rad}=\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor=\Theta(\log n)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class on $[n]$, $\mathrm{Rad}=n$, while $\mathrm{sUSC}=1$.
proof: The full-cube and singleton value calculations yield unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
